units.source_text: “瞧！这镜子安放在这儿，我丝毫也不觉得铺张奢侈，因为它随时都能照见院子里的精子和卵子。”

en.t: "Look! With this mirror set here, I do not feel the least bit that it is extravagant, because at any moment it can reflect the sperm and ova in the courtyard."

units.source_text: 这句话是夫人在百货店的人将西式化妆桌送来的时候，蓦地对丈夫说的。

en.t: These were the words the lady suddenly said to her husband when the people from the department store delivered the Western-style dressing table.

units.source_text: 也就是说，急于讨好丈夫的夫人，在镜子里首先看到的就是这个温室式的玻璃屋顶。

en.t: In other words, the lady, eager to please her husband, first saw in the mirror this greenhouse-like glass roof.

units.source_text: 要说这句话带点娇嗔，未免显得有点奇妙，

en.t: To say that there was a touch of coquettish sulking in those words may sound a little strange,

units.source_text: 不过，任何夫妇似乎都会用在他人听来显得有点奇妙的语言相互亲昵温存，从而忘却了蕴涵在这个过程中的悲剧。

en.t: but it seems that any married couple will use words that sound somewhat strange to others to be tender and intimate with one another, and so forget the tragedy contained in that very process.

units.source_text: 再说，也许所有的戏谑滑稽、俏皮妙语都只不过是人的悲剧的表现，

en.t: Besides, perhaps all joking, comedy, and clever wit are nothing more than expressions of human tragedy,

units.source_text: 因此，夫人甚至没有察觉她的语言里含有一星半点的奇妙劲儿。

en.t: and therefore the lady did not even notice the slightest trace of strangeness in her own words.

units.source_text: 然而，她之所以没有察觉（啊！蔚蓝的天空），或许也是因为镜子里映现的蔚蓝的天空，使她震惊不已，令她魂牵梦萦。

en.t: Yet perhaps the reason she did not notice it (ah, the azure sky!) was also that the azure sky reflected in the mirror shocked her deeply and possessed her soul.

units.source_text: （从蔚蓝天空降落的宛如银色小飞砾的小鸟。

en.t: (Birds descending from the azure sky like tiny silver flying pebbles.

units.source_text: 大海里逐渐消失的银箭般飞驰的帆船。

en.t: Sailboats racing like silver arrows as they gradually vanish into the sea.

units.source_text: 湖水中活像银针般穿梭的游鱼。）

en.t: Fish darting through the lake water just like silver needles.)

units.source_text: 夫人隐隐约约地看见了这些肉眼看不见的东西。

en.t: The lady dimly saw these things that the naked eye cannot see.

units.source_text: 她的肌肤感觉到银色的鱼的肌体般的冰冷，那是因为如同初次望见蔚蓝的天空，感到震惊不已。

en.t: Her skin felt a coldness like the body of a silver fish, because she was shaken as though seeing the azure sky for the first time.

units.source_text: 尽管这种震惊与孤单的寂寞是同样的东西，然而，倘使把诸如蔚蓝的天空、大海、湖水之类，视作当今人们能想象到的远古人类的感情中最为显著的物质，

en.t: Although this shock and lonely solitude are the same thing, if things such as the azure sky, the sea, and lake water are regarded as the most conspicuous substance of ancient human feeling that people today can imagine,

units.source_text: 那么夫人的寂寞就是原始性的悲哀。

en.t: then the lady's loneliness was a primitive sorrow.

units.source_text: 也就是说，镜子里映现的温室式的玻璃屋顶，蓦地把夫人的心窝整个都掏空了。

en.t: In other words, the greenhouse-like glass roof reflected in the mirror suddenly hollowed out the lady's heart completely.
